out.ogDescription:
Welcome to 27 Beatrix Street, Point Cook — a home that truly defines modern luxury and elegant design. Set on a generous 16m x 28m allotment, its wide frontage creates a commanding street presence, while the French Gable façade in muted pastel blue with crisp white trims immediately sets a sophisticated tone. From the moment you step inside, the wide entrance, premium timber flooring, and soaring 3-metre ceilings throughout establish an immediate sense of grandeur and openness.

At the front of the home, a spacious lounge provides the perfect retreat for quiet relaxation or hosting guests in style. Flowing seamlessly through to the heart of the residence, the open-plan kitchen, dining, and living areas deliver a lifestyle of comfort and flexibility. The chef's kitchen impresses with a waterfall stone benchtop, unique splashback, induction cooktop, quality appliances, pendant lighting, and premium cabinetry with ample storage. Enhancing functionality, a fully operational butler's kitchen is fitted with a 5-burner cooktop, 900mm stainless steel appliances, and additional storage, making entertaining effortless.

Accommodation is thoughtfully designed with four generously sized bedrooms, including a master suite privately positioned at the rear of the home for peace and relaxation. The master is complemented by a walk-in robe and a luxurious ensuite with floor-to-ceiling tiles, extended shower, double vanity, and freestanding bathtub. The additional bedrooms are well-appointed with built-in robes — with the fourth bedroom offering flexibility as a sunroom — and are serviced by a central bathroom with premium fittings, extended shower, bathtub, and double vanity.

The home's interiors are bright and airy, enhanced by double-glazed windows that not only flood the spaces with natural light but also ensure year-round comfort. Multiple living zones add versatility for families, while stylish bathrooms and finishes throughout reinforce the home's modern appeal.

Luxury inclusions extend beyond the interiors, with central heating and cooling, solar panels, downlights throughout, and a comprehensive security system including cameras and alarm. The double garage comes fitted with built-in storage cabinets running the length of one wall, offering excellent practicality. Outdoors, the low-maintenance backyard with artificial grass provides space for children to play, while a fully decked alfresco ensures year-round entertaining in style.

Perfectly positioned, this property enjoys unrivalled convenience. Families will appreciate being zoned to Homestead Senior Secondary College, with Carranballac P-9 College, Point Cook P-9 College, and Alamanda College also close by. The home is just minutes from Tribeca Village, Soho Village, Sanctuary Lakes Shopping Centre, Saltwater Community Centre, and Saltwater Sports Reserve, as well as wetlands, sporting ovals, and medical facilities. Commuters benefit from easy access to public transport, major freeways, and Melbourne CBD, only 21km away.

27 Beatrix Street is more than just a home — it is a statement of luxury, space, and lifestyle in one of Point Cook's most desirable communities. Contact Amit Chahal on 0437 779 139 today to arrange a private inspection and experience this remarkable property for yourself.

The Property
Welcome to 28 Lincolnheath Boulevard, Point Cook. Spanning across two levels, this remarkable residence showcases soaring ceilings, an abundance of natural light and lush garden surrounds. Expansive living zones extend throughout, with impressive ceiling heights and large windows framing beautiful leafy outlooks. Quality finishes complement the home's striking design features, while picturesque gardens create a beautiful backdrop throughout. Magnificent in scale yet wonderfully inviting, this is a residence filled with character and sophistication. Perfectly situated within the Lincoln Heath Estate, surrounded by parklands and within easy reach of Point Cook's shopping, schools, recreation facilities and key transport connections.

The Point of Difference
- Designed across two beautifully appointed levels, the home features a sweeping staircase, soaring ceilings and striking feature walls. Separate lounge, family and dining zones provide an abundance of space for everyday living and hosting guests.
- Five bedrooms provide excellent accommodation across both levels, with the fifth bedroom downstairs also suited as a study or home office. - The well-equipped kitchen features a large island bench, extensive cabinetry, stainless-steel appliances, gas cooktop and excellent preparation space, together with a spacious meals area.

- Additional highlights include ducted heating, evaporative cooling, ceiling fans, a separate laundry, ample storage, water tank, double garage and additional parking within the driveway.

Enjoying a coveted address within the Lincoln Heath Estate, the home is surrounded by a wealth of lifestyle amenities. Lincoln Heath Reserve, local parklands and sporting facilities provide excellent recreational options, while Sanctuary Lakes Shopping Centre and Point Cook Town Centre offer a vibrant mix of shopping, dining and essential services. Zoned to Carranballac P-9 College and close to childcare options, the area is well served by bus connections to Williams Landing Station.
